name: Widebody Wing (787-class)
description: Right wing of a 787-class twin-aisle airliner (approximate public planform) with all moving surfaces: inboard Krueger flap and six slats on the leading edge; dropped-hinge inboard and outboard flaps (two supports each, split panels, driven rotary actuators), flaperon behind the engine and outboard aileron on the trailing edge; seven spoilers. Drive groups move each kind of surface together.
